mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the follower to the wings was most worthwhile: the explanation showed clearly how up-and-down motion becomes wing rotation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding scales was brief and felt less engaging than making the mechanism work.

surprise.text: The crank test revealed that the wings scraped against the body, although similar rubbing problems in earlier builds made it less surprising.

arbitrary.text: The final screwdriver action had an unclear purpose when offered, though releasing the base made sense afterward.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see what the fair does with the constructions, though I hope for less repetition of spacing fixes and more meaningful choices.
